title: 1. Data controller
body: Vicente de Silva Ortiz (natural person), Quilax pre-launch operator. Tax ID and address will be completed when the company is formed. Contact: Settings → Support / tickets.

title: 2. Data we process
body: Identity and contact (name, email), game data, KYC (ID and selfie), banking/payments via Stripe, messages/support, and technical security data.

title: 3. Purposes
body: Providing the service, preventing fraud, prizes, deposits/withdrawals, support and legal obligations.

title: 4. Legal basis
body: Contract performance, legitimate interest in anti-fraud security and, where applicable, consent or legal obligation.

title: 5. Processors and third parties
body: We don't sell your data. We share what's necessary with Stripe, hosting, identity verification and authorities when required.

title: 6. Retention and deletion
body: Export or delete your account in Settings → Personal info. Deletion anonymizes personal data; some game/payment records may be kept without identifying you for legal periods.

title: 7. Your rights (GDPR)
body: Access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability in-app (export / delete) or via support. You may also complain to your DPA.

title: 8. Minors
body: Quilax is 18+ only. Registration and money operations are enforced server-side.

title: 9. Security
body: HTTPS, access controls and 2FA on deposit/withdraw in Wallet (if you enable it).

title: 10. Changes
body: We may update this policy and will notify you of material changes in the app.
